title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-01 Deligne working record: Manin 1987 letter sections 1 through 3.2
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so Deligne material can be cited, revised, or reorganized independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing. The first PDFs are cumulative working readers for the Deligne papers touched so far: one English translation reader and one French source/working-LaTeX reader. Individual English paper PDFs, selected French source/working PDFs, and separate correspondence items are also exposed for direct download. Broader reference PDFs and TeX/source artifacts are kept in ZIP files rather than cluttering the front-facing reader list.

Status at a glance. [######----] active touched-paper stream: 19 paper-level English working translations are in the current cumulative reader; [########--] correspondence stream: 16 Deligne letters or letter sections are available in English with paired French working PDFs where supplied; [####------] French source or working-LaTeX top-level readers are present for 13 selected papers, with broader original/reference material preserved in ZIP artifacts; [##########] original/reference and provenance material is preserved. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Latest update. Added a cumulative Deligne-to-Manin 1987 letter reader for sections 1 through 3.2, plus individual section readers and source material in artifacts.
